An amendment after a `verification.mutated_workspace` stop cites the stopped command and summarizes `changed_paths` and `index_changed`, proving writes but not their full surface or writer; it reshapes each writing command, inventorying no writes, never calls that command pure, and names any other writer to drop or state as a limitation.

After that mutation stop, once the caller establishes a trusted state, it takes the stopped command, `changed_paths`, and `index_changed` to a Blueprint amendment as for a `plan-contradiction`, never rerunning that sealed plan unchanged
